name: Dinosauria: Alpha+
detailed_description:
Survive as a young dinosaur in a vibrant world! Traverse lush jungles, wastelands, or dangerous volcanic terrains. Hunt, explore, avoid deadly hazards, and collect memories before the great catastrophe changes everything.

Dinosauria: Alpha+ is an action-adventure survival game with arcade elements, where you play as a young dinosaur striving to build a lasting legacy. Begin your journey by following your mighty parent and learning the ways of survival before facing the dangers of the world alone. Explore diverse biomes, survive devastating natural disasters, and collect unique dinosaur cards that preserve the story of your lineage.

Mysterious ancient relics and ruins hint at secrets buried beneath the earth. As extinction looms, uncover lost powers and face the trials needed to shape your destiny — but survival won't end with a single victory. Restore your scarred world and protect your future against unstoppable forces.

  • 🎴 Create a basic dinosaur card.

  • 🦖 Start as a young dinosaur following your mighty parent and experience a guided tutorial.

  • 🌴 Explore diverse biomes: jungle, desert, volcanic mountains, and more.

  • ⚔️ Face off against other dinosaurs in dynamic battles.

  • 📔 Browse a simplified card binder without Steam Inventory integration.

  • 🔥 Survive catastrophic events like meteor showers.

  • 🧩 Discover the first hints of an ancient secret that could change the fate of the world.

  • ⚡ Experience arcade hazards: volcanoes, predator stampedes, tornadoes, poisonous plants.

Key Features Planned for the future:

  • 🎴 Create your own personalized dinosaur card with colors, backgrounds, and decorations.

  • 🦖 Choose from 6 dinosaur types and customize their appearance.

  • 🌎 Explore a fully 3D, procedurally generated world with diverse biomes, enemies, and hidden locations.

  • 🥚 Build your herd and  breed up to 3 offspring

  • 🏡 Decorate your cave with plants, rocks, and ancient artifacts.

  • ⚡ Survive arcade challenges: erupting volcanoes, predator stampedes, tornadoes, meteor showers, and poisonous flora.

  • 🔥 Meteor showers dynamically reshape the terrain with impact craters and rare stones.

  • 📔 Collect and browse your card binder, saving memories of each playthrough.

  • 🧳 Save rare cards to Steam Inventory (optional collection and trading).

  • 🛠️ Design your own worlds using the integrated Map Editor, placing plants, rocks, crystals, and dinosaurs to create new environments and challenges.

  • 🌟 Uncover a deeper story quest involving ancient powers, lost relics, and a desperate race against extinction.
